text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. At its core, it involves image recognition, where a system identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. More advanced tasks include object detection, which not only recognizes objects but also locates them within an image, drawing boxes around them. This technology has many practical applications. In healthcare, it helps doctors analyze medical scans more quickly. In retail, it can track inventory automatically. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where computer vision processes camera feeds in real time to detect pedestrians, traffic lights, and other vehicles, allowing the car to navigate safely. As this technology improves, it is likely to transform many aspects of our daily lives.
